**Claude:** Next I'll check the localStorage keys used by the existing solo pages (a collision risk), plus the shared `TossupBonusRoom` and the page HTML.

**Claude:** The storage keys are distinct from the existing pages, so there's no collision. Now the rest of the engine, so I know what the unit tests need to cover.

**Claude:** Before writing scenarios, I want to see who else reads `questionIndex` (the shared `QuestionRoom` change affects multiplayer too) and how the existing solo bonus room differs from the new one.

**Claude:** Now the actual test scenarios.

**Claude:** The flow suite is now 50/50. The packet suite didn't run because of a shell typo in my `echo`, so I'll rerun it.

**User:** Tool loaded.

**Claude:** The 401 is the logged-out auth check, which every page makes. Now a full play-through in the real page. I'll turn off type-to-answer so "Reveal" gives deterministic correct answers.

**Claude:** The tossup-to-bonus handoff works in the real page. Here is the bonus state visually.

**Claude:** The bonus score reflects the overrule: 20 pts, stats 0/1/0/0. Next is the key new behavior, overruling a tossup verdict and seeing the bonus follow it.

**Claude:** The room does clear (totals reset to 1 tossup, not 2), so the display isn't refreshing after the clear. I'll trace how a `clear-stats` message travels through the client class chain.

**Claude:** In set-name mode, tossup N and bonus N pair up from the same packet (packet 1, questions 1–3, 21 per packet). Now persistence across a reload.

**Claude:** The feature is not ready for a PR yet. There is one blocking bug, in starred mode, plus a lesser one in local-packet mode.
